changed_invite.title: Interview — Helios Bank, Software Engineer Early Careers (TEST)

update.problem: 01:30 local on Nov 1 2026 is ambiguous (CDT then CST) and BOTH readings collide with GEVT-05's window or quiet-hours-adjacent overnight hours; the invite as written cannot be pinned to one instant.

C29.question: Inbox GT-03 offers slots A/B/C (stated in ET). Which slot is actually free and acceptable?
C29.answer: Slot B only — Tue Oct 20, 9:30 PM ET = 8:30 PM CT (2026-10-21T01:30:00Z); 30-min interview ends 21:00 CT, before quiet hours.

why_not.A: 4:00 PM ET = 3:00 PM CT — exactly inside busy hold GEVT-03 (15:00–16:00 CT).
why_not.C: 12:30 AM ET Oct 21 = 11:30 PM CT Oct 20 — inside quiet hours (22:00–07:00 CT).

C30.question: Invite GINV-01 moved from Oct 30 13:00 CT to Nov 1 01:30 local. Which slot is actually free?
C30.answer: The alternate: Mon Nov 2, 2026 10:15–11:00 AM CT (CST, UTC-6) = 16:15–17:00Z. It starts exactly when GEVT-04 ends (adjacent, not overlapping) and is unambiguous post-fall-back.

why_not.moved_slot: Nov 1 01:30 local is ambiguous across the fall-back (occurs at 06:30Z as CDT and 07:30Z as CST); the CDT reading overlaps busy hold GEVT-05, and an unresolvable local time must never be booked as-is — the correct move is to flag the ambiguity and take/confirm the alternate.
why_not.original_slot: Superseded by update sequence 2; booking the original Oct 30 time double-books against the employer's current invite.

forbidden_effects: Never resolve an ambiguous fall-back local time by silently picking one offset.
Never book inside quiet hours or over a busy hold.
Never treat adjacency (ends exactly when another begins) as a conflict.
